candidate_ideas.statement: After constructing a suitable relative divisor or Abel–Jacobi incidence space and comparing scheme structures, the relative evaluation-failure scheme may equal the finite étale S_6-cover of its reduced-support locus.
For a tetragonal g^1_4 divisor D, one may have W_5≅ω_C^{⊗2}(-D).
The numerical package dim(Hurwitz)=15, dim(Z)=17, and codim_{M_{6,6}}(Z)=4 may describe the relevant incidence geometry.

established_facts.evidence: SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 excerpt gives the degree formula and the sign in γ^*O(-f).
established_facts.statement: For W_f=(O_{P(E^∨)}(2)⊗γ^*O_{P^1}(-f))|_C on a smooth genus-6 curve, deg(W_f)=4g+12-4f.

established_facts.evidence: The degree is 4·4+6-2·6-14=-4; a negative-degree line bundle on a smooth projective curve has no nonzero global section.
established_facts.statement: For every ordered reduced degree-six divisor Γ, H^0(C,ω_C⊗W_4^∨(Γ))=0.

established_facts.evidence: The obstruction line bundle has degree 4·5+6-2·6-14=0. A degree-zero line bundle on a smooth projective connected curve has a nonzero section exactly when it is trivial.
established_facts.statement: Fibrewise, H^0(C,ω_C⊗W_5^∨(Γ))≠0 if and only if O_C(Γ)≅W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}.
For L=W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}, χ(L)=1 and h^0(L)≥1 on every smooth geometric fibre.

established_facts.evidence: The canonical geometric bottleneck specifies the reduced-support open and its finite étale S_6 ordering cover.
established_facts.statement: The locus of reduced degree-six divisors with six distinct support points is open, and ordering their support defines a finite étale S_6-cover.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Equality on geometric points does not determine nilpotents, multiplicities, or determinantal scheme structure; a comparison of obstruction complexes or Fitting ideals is required.
invalid_steps.statement: A fibrewise equivalence on geometric points implies equality of the relative evaluation-failure scheme and the residual Abel–Jacobi incidence scheme over an arbitrary base.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Without local freeness and cohomology-and-base-change hypotheses, Proj(π_*L) need not have the required fibres or commute with base change; a compatible Hilbert or Abel–Jacobi construction is needed.
invalid_steps.statement: When h^0(L) may jump, the relative linear system is automatically Proj(π_*L), interchangeably with the relative effective-divisor Hilbert functor.

reusable_computations.statement: Degree arithmetic for W_5 and W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}: 4·6+12-4·5=16 and 16-(2·6-2)=6.
Obstruction-degree arithmetic for n=6: deg(ω_C⊗W_5^∨(Γ))=0 and deg(ω_C⊗W_4^∨(Γ))=-4.

unresolved_dependencies.statement: Construct a relative effective-divisor or Abel–Jacobi incidence space compatible with arbitrary base change when h^0(L) jumps.
Compare the determinantal or Fitting scheme structure of the CE evaluation-failure locus with the residual incidence scheme.
Construct the relevant universal moduli stack of balanced tetragonal Casnati–Ekedahl data and the global map of the incidence locus to M_{6,6}.
Determine the components, dimensions, stabilizers, and finite-cover behavior of the incidence locus.
Determine whether the exact codimension-13 contribution supported on the incidence locus is Tate and whether any non-Tate summand survives in W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q).
Assemble the tetragonal contribution into the exact lowest-weight group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q).
